content.what_it_is: TIDE_MODULE implements constant or time-series tide/surge relaxation boundaries (L63-L864). TIDE_INITIAL reads activation/type/width, loads constant values or opens four directional series, allocates and constructs decay fields, and removes overlapping generic sponge widths for absorb-only tide boundaries (L106-L211). TIDE_SPONGE builds west/east/south/north exponential relaxation weights (L214-L267); TIDE_BC relaxes eta/u/v within boundary strips (L269-L323). Tide_READ_CONSTANT configures each side from scalar inputs (L325-L469); REMOVE_SPONGE disables corresponding generic sponges (L472-L526); Tide_READ_DATA_INIT opens units 201-204 and seeds first samples (L528-L666); TIDE_DATA advances file records and linearly interpolates side values at TIME (L668-L861).
entities: tide filenames/type L77-L80; activation and side flags L81-L86; side eta/u/v L87-L90; sponge arrays L91-L92; widths/files L93; paired time-series samples L94-L101

unresolved: REMOVE_SPONGE's all-sides-disabled condition tests TideWest once and TideEast three times at L515-L516, omitting TideSouth and TideNorth. If west/east are absent but south or north is valid, it wrongly sets TIDAL_BC_ABS=.FALSE. at L517; this is a direct copy/paste defect.

Iwidth_tide is accepted without range checks, copied to Iwidth at L221, and used as the divisor Iwidth-1 at L230/L238/L247/L255. A value of 1 causes division by zero; values <=0 or larger than Mloc/Nloc also make the TIDE_BC strip loops L277-L313 invalid or out of bounds.

TIDE_SPONGE globalizes local positions with npx*Mglob/px and npy*Nglob/py at L230-L255, assuming equal block sizes. INDEX instead supports uneven remainder partitions through grid_range_per_procs. When Mglob or Nglob is not divisible by PX/PY, sponge positions are shifted at rank boundaries; iista/jjsta are imported but unused.

All four time-series READ statements branch to the single label 120 at L859 on EOF (west L685, east L732, south L778, north L824). EOF on an earlier side skips that side's interpolation and every later side for the whole call; repeated calls encounter the same EOF again, so west exhaustion can permanently suppress east/south/north updates. The intended 'no more data' equality logic is bypassed by the jump.

The time-series files opened on units 201-204 at L556/L587/L617/L647 are never closed. More importantly, after EOF the code neither freezes the last value nor disables the side; control jumps out before interpolation, leaving boundary values at their prior call and preventing subsequent-side processing.

Both TIDAL_BC_ABS and TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS may be true; initialization allocates one shared set of sponges, but main calls TIDE_BC only under TIDAL_BC_ABS while generating/absorbing behavior is handled elsewhere. This module contains no mutual-exclusion or precedence rule, so simultaneous flags can apply overlapping boundary mechanisms.
